en:
I didn't know you were here! I've been lookin'
for you everywhere!

Ah, Angie! Did you find out anything
about the flashlight?
Yep, I finally figured it out.

It seems like Atua wants us to gather in the
gym for an explanation.

You don't have time to relax now.
Bye-onara!

<CLT=cltMIND>If "Atua" is going to explain it to us,
I'm guessing she didn't figure it out.

<CLT=cltMIND>But in any case...
I should go to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>gym<CLT=cltMIND>.
